title: iphiona anthemidifolia
intro: Iphiona anthemidifolia, commonly known as Egyptian lavender, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family. The health benefits of Iphiona anthemidifolia include its ability to reduce anxiety and insomnia, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include sedation, antispasmodic, and antiseptic effects, making it useful for treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Iphiona anthemidifolia include flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
